1.title: Inside the Rushed Effort to Get Trump His New Air Force One
1.summary: A New York Times investigation found that President Trump’s push to speed delivery of the aircraft led to ballooning costs and trade-offs in safety features.

2.title: From Celebration to Escalation: How Trump’s Iran Cease-Fire Collapsed
2.summary: The U.S. deal with Iran signed in June initially appeared to be a success. It didn’t take long to fall apart.

3.title: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
3.summary: The event celebrated press freedom after the first dinner was cancelled by a shooting in April.

4.title: Live Updates: Hundreds of Thousands Flee as Fires Rage in Spain and France
4.summary: Firefighters were racing to contain blazes that were moving closer to Madrid and Bordeaux.

5.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Strikes Abate, Even as Trump Considers Escalation
5.summary: U.S. forces did not announce new overnight attacks on southern Iran for the first time in about two weeks, but tensions remained high as the Houthis and Saudi-led forces in Yemen said they had traded strikes.

6.title: Taiwan Tests How It Would Resist a Chinese Siege at Sea
6.summary: Taiwan is stepping up plans to secure fuel and other vital imports as Chinese government ships practice moves that could one day be used in a blockade.
